# Third-party: cortex-t31-calibrate (slot 207)

No new dependency and no copied code. `src/calibrate.rs`, `tests/calibration.rs` and `tests/real_calibrate.rs` use
only crates already in openmind-nerve (`serde_json`) and std. Cargo.lock unchanged.
